{{Youmay|the element|[[Mercury (Dreadnaught-class)]]}}
'''Mercury''' (Hg)<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> was a liquid metal element at room temperatures. It was poisonous to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]; however some lifeforms like the [[Polydroxol]]s evolved in mercury-rich environments. It flowed on the [[Cinnabar Moon]]. The mantle and much of the surface of [[Fiddanl]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] was composed of a massive sea of boiling mercury.<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>

On board the [[Lido Deck]] of the [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]], [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']], passengers were able to swim in a competition-sized [[swimming pool]] that contained mercury and [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]].<ref name="RPG" />
